name: Santorini's Greek Grill & The Great Greek (Herriman & Draper) Lemon-Free Chicken Souvlaki, Rice & Pita
brandOrRestaurant: Santorini's Greek Grill (Mountain View Village · Herriman) / The Great Greek (Draper, UT)
whyItWorks: Located in Mountain View Village right by Holiday Inn Express Herriman (and on 12300 S in Draper): warm fluffy pita bread, basmati rice pilaf, and shaved gyro meat or grilled chicken skewers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Build-Your-Own Rice Bowl or Pita with shaved Gyro meat (citrus-free!) or plain grilled chicken over white rice with smooth hummus and warm pita—skipping raw onions, tomatoes, and lemon-herb dressing.
watchOuts: CITRUS WARNING: Greek chicken marinades and avgolemono soup often contain lemon—choose shaved Gyro meat or confirm chicken is lemon-free!
